harms_status_overrides.notes: A measured performance trade-off is explicitly reported, but the seed does not establish a systematic adverse-event assessment.

harm_observations.harm_label: Immediate JOL prompting worsened difficult learning in some conditions
harm_observations.result_summary: Memory performance was null overall and negative when learning was difficult.
harm_observations.evidence_basis: Reviewed route rationale states that immediate judgments of learning did not improve learning and sometimes harmed difficult learning; normalized outcome direction is null_overall_negative_when_difficult.

participation_observations.evidence_basis: Reviewed seed sample_json reports 22 participants at second scan.

implementation_observations.evidence_basis: Normalized component delivery_mode explicitly states guided cognitive training.
Normalized component delivery_mode explicitly states researcher-facilitated tablet games.
Normalized component delivery_mode explicitly states structured matching-to-sample training.

implementation_observations.value_text: 8-week comparison of no AI, bounded AI plus compulsory reflection, and open AI collaboration, with supervised no-AI follow-up
implementation_observations.evidence_basis: Reviewed protocol explicitly records the three conditions and the Week 8 supervised no-AI writing task.

support_dependence_observations.evidence_basis: Week 8 outcome was measured on a supervised no-AI writing task after the intervention period. This demonstrates performance without AI at that test, but does not by itself establish spontaneous cue recovery or prompt fading.

boundary_observations.boundary_summary: Spontaneous cue recovery and prompt fading were not demonstrated.
boundary_observations.evidence_basis: Reviewed route rationale explicitly states that authentic writing plus later no-AI performance makes this partial Bridge, but spontaneous cue recovery/prompt fading were not demonstrated.

boundary_observations.boundary_summary: AI reduced subjective effort but did not produce the expected objective speed advantage; perceived speedup was overestimated.
boundary_observations.evidence_basis: Reviewed source reports no-AI speed advantage, AI speed overestimation, and lower subjective effort with AI.

boundary_observations.boundary_summary: Dependent offloading was associated with less favourable perceived downstream cognitive functioning than autonomous offloading.
boundary_observations.evidence_basis: Three-wave observational source distinguishes dependent from autonomous generative-AI offloading; the association is non-causal and informs Bridge/Redesign boundaries only.

notes: Participation flow is not treated as adherence or withdrawal due to harm.
No fidelity, provider, tailoring, modification, burden or cost judgement is inferred where not explicitly supported.
Support-dependence observations do not auto-create Stage 4 Bridge evidence.
